title: Repair engine reinstalls a node pack a crash left unreadable
description: A tester's PC crashed while RES4LYF rewrote res4lyf.config.json; every later engine start failed to import RES4LYF (JSONDecodeError) and blocked generation. Repair engine only re-ran pip, which cannot fix a pack's own files. The repair now re-fetches each pack that failed to import at its pinned commit.
